recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore InventoryReport to core for FHIR-29208; future InventoryReport changes should be made in the OO additional-resources/incubator repository unless OO/FMG explicitly decides to migrate the resource back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-29208 was a Published FHIR-core OO change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking to start a draft Inventory Status Report resource in the FHIR R5 build to support discussion and a resource proposal.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit d859feaadf9f9a93eb140df22024b99294ef3cd9 started adding InventoryReport source, and merge commit 84488dd4c5694d8e2a1a491b7dcbe8a3496598bc for PR #1022 explicitly says Applied FHIR-29208. The v5.0.0 tag contains active inventoryreport fhir.ini metadata and InventoryReport resource-list/workflow links, confirming publication in R5.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has no active InventoryReport or inventoryreport entry, and current core narrative links InventoryReport to the OO incubator IG. Later evidence, including commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32, FMG/OO Zulip discussion, and Jira FHIR-53282, shows InventoryReport was intentionally moved into the additional-resources/incubator track for R6-era work.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The seed's requested R5 addition was already implemented and published, while the current build deliberately excludes InventoryReport from active core metadata; orphan source/inventoryreport files are not build-scope without fhir.ini inclusion.

related_jiras.note: Tracks OO Additional Resources configuration for R6 and lists InventoryReport among affected artifacts; it supports the externalization context but is a separate Resolved - change required issue not decided here.
